measurementMethod.actualPaintedInk: sequential unique-color paint isolation (SVG stroke/fill/descendants restored)
measurementMethod.referencePaintedInk: pixels inside curated mask matching inkMode
measurementMethod.note: Geometric and painted-ink bounds are reported separately and never mixed. Global mismatch% is informational only — overlay composition is authoritative.

headingTitleContamination.note: Loose L>=160 detector on reference can include glow/AA below glyphs; dense L>=180 is glyph ink.

implementationNote: Production renders native HTML/CSS/SVG only. Reference imagery is QA/documentation-only and is never loaded by ProcessSection production dependencies.
